decisions.reason: As an organic extension of the core salami range with several variants, it fits the firm’s declared expansion of organic lines and invites continued commitment despite only modest public visibility so far.
This product matches the organic push and was given its own page, so management is likely to persist, though as a narrower single snack concept it is somewhat easier to withdraw than a broader line.

The premium sharing snack stays close to the firm’s established meat-specialty capabilities and, with several models and its own page, represents a visible commitment that management would be inclined to continue.
